connector.name: lean-memory
connector.registryDescription: Embedded, local-first agent memory: one SQLite file per namespace, no server, no cloud.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package lean-memory. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the wuesteon account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.

env.name: LM_DATA_ROOT
env.description: Directory for per-namespace SQLite memory files. Defaults to ~/.lean_memory when unset.
